annotations.title: Andamento del prezzo di un prodotto

description: Use this when the user asks how much a common grocery or household product costs in Italy this week, whether it is getting cheaper or more expensive, or which chain has it cheapest: e.g. "how much does pasta cost this week", "is coffee more expensive than last week". Returns the typical (median) and lowest flyer price this week, the previous weeks and each chain this week, with the link to the product page on prezzinvista.it. Covers Italy only, and about two hundred staple products (pasta, caffè, olio di oliva, latte, detersivo, pannolini, …), named in Italian; specific brands and models are what search_flyer_offers looks up. In hosts that support MCP Apps the results are also shown to the user as a card with the weekly trend.

product.description: The product, in Italian: e.g. "pasta", "caffè", "olio di oliva", "detersivo lavatrice".

name: get_price_trend

change_note.description: When there is no percentage: how this week compares with the week before

change_percent.description: This week against the week before, only when the change is clear

previous_typical_price_eur.description: Median the week before, when comparable

prices_are.description: per kg, per l, per pack (groceries) or per item (appliances)

source.description: Who to credit for the data

updated_at.description: When the flyers were last read (ISO 8601). They are read again every three hours

title: Andamento del prezzo di un prodotto
